notes.title: The report about a problem which some user can't install the game.
notes.content:
Thank you for always playing TITANSLAYER II.

In response to your inquiry that ""the game can not be 
played properly"", 
I confirmed this issue with Valve's steam team.  
It turned out that it was a problem that occurred when using 
Beta version keys distributed for media before the release.

These keys become unusable after the release.
Please purchase released version of TITANSLAYER II from Steam.

In addition, we will issue the latest key once again only for 
users who have inquired directly to us via email and received the 
Beta key.
Sorry for your inconvenience but please contact us with the e-mail 
address you used to contact us before.

I am sorry for troubling you. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Patch Notes ver0.1.2
notes.content:
Hello, all slayers!!
As we had already informed, we release a patch to experience more comfortable game play.

　- You can select the way you hold your weapon. Holding trigger button or toggle the button to hold.
　- You can turn off blood from option menu.
　- Fix the issue which had landed in unexpected place when player fell off from the ladder.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33783733/5e8cb694b4f51e84fa898bac8d07de65423d7d7c.png[/img]

Your feedback and comments are always welcome to improve t【TITAN SLAYER Ⅱ】. Let’s make the great game together!

notes.title: Hello, all slayers!!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for giving many feedback and comments to us.
Our team are pleased to have your comments for this.
We try to absorb your feedback as much as possible and make the game lot better.

As a first step, we are planning to release some patch to fix an issue which many of you are pointing out in feedback.
Currently you have to keep holding a trigger button to activate weapons.
The new toggle system will let you keep holding a weapon once you have them with trigger button and will release with Grip button so you don’t have to hold a trigger button all the time.
We will add option menu to select which system is more preferable for you.

Your feedback and comments are always welcome to improve this game. Let’s make the great game together!
